z: 耕 umzwa, isiqu sobuchopho, igumbi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu

Forgiveness does not require the betrayed to be foolish. It requires them to decide whether the person is still a member. Membership is a practice after it has been a wound.

practice: If you were the one who broke trust, say what you did without a speech about why it was almost fair.

z: 耖 umzwa, isiqu sobuchopho, igumbi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
A marriage that has lost a child, or a parent, or a future, needs presence more than explanation. Explanation is a way of leaving. Sitting is a way of staying.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by umzwa, isiqu sobuchopho, igumbi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele. 耖 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Answer the ordinary request of a grieving child. Do not make them perform a sadness you recognize.

z: 耗 umzwa, isiqu sobuchopho, igumbi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
A marriage in despair does not need a speech about gratitude. It needs one true plan for tomorrow that both people can bear. Make the plan small enough to be kept.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by umzwa, isiqu sobuchopho, igumbi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla. 耗 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Decline the word forever. Keep the true sentence about the pain, and stop before the lie.

z: 耘 umzwa, isiqu sobuchopho, igumbi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
In a marriage, revenge is often petty and therefore easy to excuse. The small cut, repeated, is how love is replaced by a contest. Mercy is leaving one cut unanswered.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by umzwa, isiqu sobuchopho, igumbi, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 耘 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Tell the truth of the wrong once, to the person, and then do not serve it at breakfast.

z: 耙 umzwa, isiqu sobuchopho, igumbi, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu
line:
Accountability begins when you can say, the heat was mine. Wisdom begins when you can say, it had a better door. Compassion begins when the person you nearly burned is still in the room, and you stay.

practice: If you have already burned someone you love, say so before the day ends, and then do one ordinary kindness with your hands.

z: 耜 amehlo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Self-reflection is the moment you notice you needed to win. Accountability is saying so before you are forced. The turn from pride to dignity is mostly this small honesty.

practice: Kneel, or sit, so your eyes meet a child's. Stay there until the conversation is theirs.

z: 耡 amehlo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Siblings are assigned the same story and different gifts. Envy calls this injustice. Admiration calls it a house with more than one lamp. Both lamps belong on the table.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele. 耡 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Ask the person to show you how they did the thing. Be a student for ten minutes.

z: 耤 amehlo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Many houses, under many names, give the same command: do not be ruled by dread, and do not despise the person who is. The strong are asked to stay, not to sneer.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla. 耤 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Hold the doorway. Let the frightened one see that you are not leaving.

z: 耦 amehlo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Hospitality is the oldest sociology of the lasting house. The stranger eats first. The family that cannot do this for a guest will eventually fail to do it for itself.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 耦 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Give a thing away that you still like. Do not wait until you are tired of it.

z: 耬 amehlo, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Siblings remember the name they were called on the worst day. Do not give them that name. Give them the name of the good you have actually seen them do.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 耬 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Tell one story tonight in which a person in this house is repaired, not mocked.

z: 耰 amehlo, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Children who are met with contempt learn to hide the clumsy part, which is most of them. Appreciation gives that part a chair.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele. 耰 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Ask to be shown a skill you had decided was beneath you. Watch the whole way through.

z: 耳 amehlo, phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
The old practice of sitting with the sick, of keeping watch, of not filling the air, is this turn. Do not rush to be useful. Be there.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, phezulu, ngakwesokudla. 耳 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Be findable. Tell the house which room you will be in, and be in it.

z: 耵 amehlo, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
The wisdom shared by many houses is hard: do not let the sun go down on a break you are willing to heal, and do not call it healing if you are only waiting to retell it.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 耵 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Decide, and say, whether the person is still a member. Do not leave them in a fog.

z: 耶 amehlo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Children grieve in strange hours and then ask for ordinary things. Both are grief. Answer the ordinary thing. Do not make them perform a sadness you can recognize.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 耶 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Leave the empty place unspoken-of only if the grieving person wishes it. Otherwise, speak the name.

z: 耷 amehlo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
A child who sees an adult look again, after a bad day, learns that a bad day is not a verdict. This is worth more than any optimism you could announce.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele. 耷 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Set one place at the table that despair said was pointless. Eat there.

z: 耻 amehlo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Children are the usual casualties of a score kept between adults. They did not agree to carry it. Mercy toward the person you resent is also protection of the child.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla. 耻 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Do one undeserved kindness where you are keeping score. Do not mention the score.

z: 耼 amehlo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Siblings fight because they share a roof and a hunger. The fight is not the failure. The failure is when the stronger one discovers a liking for the smaller one's fear. Protection refuses that discovery.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 耼 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: When the heat rises, name who you are actually keeping safe. Put your body between the danger and the child. Do not spend the heat on the child.

z: 耽 amehlo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Brothers and sisters are the first public. What you do to be admired at home becomes the way they will treat their own children. Give them a dignity they can copy.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 耽 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Once, take the lower seat on purpose. Let someone in the house finish a story you could have told better.

z: 耿 amehlo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
The teachings that endured all warn the eye. They also bless the eye that rejoices. Rejoicing is not a mood. It is a decision made again each time the other person shines.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele. 耿 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Say out loud, in the hearing of the person, the exact good you wished were yours. Then leave it theirs.

z: 聃 amehlo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Fear of the future makes a house small. Courage does not enlarge the future. It keeps today's people inside the house while the future remains unknown.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla. 聃 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Stay until the scared person is breathing slowly. Do not explain the dark away before you have sat in it.

z: 聆 amehlo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Psychology is simple here. The closed hand teaches the body that the world is about to run out. The open hand teaches it that tomorrow includes other people.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 聆 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Pass the best portion first. The first piece teaches the house what it is.

z: 聊 amehlo, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Gossip is how a house talks about its own when they have left the room. Healing speech waits until they are back, and then says the hard thing to the face, cleanly.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 聊 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Speak the true sentence. Keep the second one, the one that only wanted to win.

z: 聒 amehlo, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Across the old writings, the warning against scoffing is constant. A scoffer cannot be taught, and a house that scoffs cannot learn itself.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele. 聒 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Look at one ordinary object they mended or prepared, and say what it cost them.

z: 聖 amehlo, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Some truths are not ready for speech. Presence holds them without using them as a weapon. A weaponized silence is still a weapon.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla. 聖 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: If your quiet has been a punishment, break it with one gentle sentence and then stay.

z: 聘 amehlo, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
A child who watches a break become a lifelong trial learns that love is a court. A child who watches a break become a mended bowl learns that love can survive its own failure.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 聘 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: If you were the one who broke trust, say what you did without a speech about why it was almost fair.

z: 聚 amehlo, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Compassion is grief that has recognized itself in another body and does not hurry it. Hurry is fear. The unhurried hour is the gift.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 聚 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Bring food. Take the lower seat. Stay past the moment you become uncomfortable.

z: 聞 amehlo, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
The sciences of a lasting household call this resilience. The older word is faithfulness. It does not deny the dark. It refuses to let the dark be the only speaker.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele. 聞 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Make one plan for tomorrow small enough that both of you can keep it.

z: 聟 amehlo, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Many sacred traditions, in different grammars, say the same hard thing: the injury stops when someone declines to pass it on. This is not weakness. It is the end of a chain.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla. 聟 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Leave one cut unanswered today. Do not announce the leaving.

z: 聡 amehlo, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
At the table, anger wants the last word. The last word is rarely food. Let the sentence end before it becomes the story the children will tell about this house.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 聡 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Before the second loud sentence, step into the doorway, not toward the person. Let the heat guard the house from outside.

z: 聢 amehlo, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
The guest at the table is a test you did not schedule. If your worth requires the guest to be less clever, less beautiful, less faithful, your worth is a costume. Take it off.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 聢 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Kneel, or sit, so your eyes meet a child's. Stay there until the conversation is theirs.

z: 聦 amehlo, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
What you wish were yours, name it exactly, in the hearing of the person who has it. Then do not reach. The naming is the confession. The not-reaching is the turn.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele. 聦 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Ask the person to show you how they did the thing. Be a student for ten minutes.

z: 聨 amehlo, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Name the loss you are counting. Often it is a person in the room, not a disaster outside. Then put your body beside that person. That is the whole practice.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla. 聨 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Hold the doorway. Let the frightened one see that you are not leaving.

z: 聯 amehlo, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Give before you calculate whether you will be thanked. Thanks are not the food. If you require them, you have made a trade, and a trade is not yet a family.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 聯 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Feed the guest, or the youngest, before you take your own share.

z: 聰 amehlo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Wisdom is not silence forever. There is a time to speak. The test is whether the words can be repeated in front of the person, and still be a kindness.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 聰 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Say the hard thing to the face, once, cleanly, with no audience.

z: 聱 amehlo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Look at the work you have stopped seeing. Name it. The naming is not flattery. It is the return of sight, and sight is the turn.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele. 聱 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Remove the sneer from a sentence and speak it again. Notice how much of it was only the sneer.

z: 聲 amehlo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to be interesting. You do have to be in the house.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla. 聲 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Sit with a person who is not ready to speak. Let ten minutes pass without fixing them.

z: 聳 amehlo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Accountability is the first half. Without it, forgiveness is a fog. The one who broke the trust says what was done, without a speech about why it was almost justified.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 聳 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Decide, and say, whether the person is still a member. Do not leave them in a fog.

z: 聴 amehlo, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu
line:
The oldest writings are full of lament, not because lament is holy by itself, but because love that cannot lament becomes hard. Let the house be soft enough to cry.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by amehlo, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu. 聴 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Leave the empty place unspoken-of only if the grieving person wishes it. Otherwise, speak the name.

z: 聵 i-cochlea, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Despair often tells the truth about pain and then adds a lie about forever. Keep the truth. Decline the forever. Forever is not a fact available to a person at a window.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by i-cochlea, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 聵 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Set one place at the table that despair said was pointless. Eat there.

z: 聶 i-cochlea, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Accountability remains. Mercy is not the cancellation of truth. It is the decision that truth will not be used as a knife at breakfast for the next twenty years.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by i-cochlea, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele. 聶 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: If a child is carrying a feud that belongs to adults, take it back. Say that it is not theirs.

z: 職 i-cochlea, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
An elder who has turned anger into protection does not become mild. The wall is still warm. What changes is the face it turns toward. It faces the street, not the cradle.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by i-cochlea, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla. 職 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Teach the strong child to stand in front of the smaller one. That is anger, turned, and it can be learned young.

z: 聹 i-cochlea, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
An elder's dignity is not the right to be obeyed in every small thing. It is the right to be respected while still listening. The listening is what makes the respect true.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by i-cochlea, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 聹 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Praise a person in the house for a quality you do not share. Do not add a correction.

z: 聻 i-cochlea, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Across generations, envy of the young is fear of being finished. Admiration of the young is how an elder stays in the story without owning it.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by i-cochlea, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 聻 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: When a sibling is praised, add one true sentence of your own. Do not balance it with your own news.

z: 聽 i-cochlea, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
An elder who has been afraid and stayed is a better teacher than an elder who claims never to have shaken. The shaking, survived, is the lesson.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by i-cochlea, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele. 聽 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Stay until the scared person is breathing slowly. Do not explain the dark away before you have sat in it.

z: 聾 i-cochlea, phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
An elder who gives the best piece away is not being careless with the future. The elder is showing the future how a house continues.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by i-cochlea, phezulu, ngakwesokudla. 聾 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Pass the best portion first. The first piece teaches the house what it is.

z: 聿 i-cochlea, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
An elder's stories are a kind of speech that builds or bends a family. Tell the story in which people are repaired. The other story will tell itself.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by i-cochlea, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 聿 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Speak the true sentence. Keep the second one, the one that only wanted to win.

z: 肄 i-cochlea, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
An elder who still notices the small faithfulness in the house is a gift to the young. The young become what is noticed.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by i-cochlea, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. 肄 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Thank a person for a labor you have stopped seeing. Thank the labor, not their temperament.

z: 肅 i-cochlea, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
An elder's quiet can be a shelter or a locked door. The young can tell which, by whether they are welcome to come and say nothing beside you.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by i-cochlea, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele. 肅 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to perform a talk.

z: 肆 i-cochlea, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Some breaks end a household. That too can be told with dignity. Forgiveness then is the refusal to poison the years that follow. The children still have to live in them.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by i-cochlea, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla. 肆 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Name the break once, without extra charges. Then do one small trustworthy thing, and repeat it tomorrow.

z: 肇 i-cochlea, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
An elder who speaks of the dead by name, without recruiting the young into despair, gives the family its memory and its future in the same breath.

This is the work of a marriage. Here the body speaks by i-cochlea, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. 肇 does not replace it. The character stands aside, the way a true name stands beside a person and does not erase the face.
practice: Do not hurry a grieving person into cheer. Let the absent name be said.

z: 肉 i-cochlea, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:

line:

Envy is love of a good thing, twisted until the good thing must shrink. The love was real. That is why it hurts. Turned, the same look becomes admiration, which is fed by another person's light.

Greed is the fear that there will not be enough, wearing the mask of appetite. Bread kept in a closed hand goes stale. Generosity is the same hand remembering the table.

practice: Say the hard thing to the face, once, cleanly, with no audience.

line:
There is a silence that punishes and a silence that accompanies. They use the same closed mouth. The difference is whether the person has left while remaining in the chair.

line:

line:

line:
A marriage can survive a true no. It cannot survive a no that was only a wound looking for a second body. Protection is the no that guards the bond, not the no that wins the evening.

practice: Teach the strong child to stand in front of the smaller one. That is anger, turned, and it can be learned young.

line:
A parent who comes down to a child's height does not lose rank. Rank was the costume. The person remains. Dignity is the choice to be seen without requiring worship.

practice: Praise a person in the house for a quality you do not share. Do not add a correction.

A family that can clap for its own is already rich. The eye is the first thief, and it can be the first blessing. The difference is whether the good is allowed to remain in the other hand.

line:
The parent at the dark door does not stop being afraid. They stop leaving. Be with the frightened. Do not perform fearlessness. A performed bravery teaches a child to hide.

line:
Generosity is not the opposite of need. It is need that has remembered other mouths. The first portion, not the remainder, teaches the house what it is.

line:
Healing speech is not sweetness. Sweetness can be a lie. Healing speech is accuracy with mercy. It names the hurt and refuses the insult that wanted to ride along.

practice: Tell one story tonight in which a person in this house is repaired, not mocked.

line:
What is despised at home is despised twice, because home was the place it should have been safe to be plain. Appreciation is looking that did not turn away.

In a marriage, the punishing quiet can last longer than a blow, and it teaches the same lesson: you are alone in this room. Presence refuses to teach that.

Name the break once, plainly, without the extra charges that make you feel righteous. Then do one small trustworthy thing, and do it again tomorrow. Trust is rebuilt at that size.

A child who is envied by a parent carries a weight no child can name. Admiration from above is a kind of safety. It says, your becoming does not threaten my place.

A child learns courage from a body that does not abandon the feeling. Sit until the breath slows. Explanation can wait. Presence cannot.

line:

z: 胳 umgogodla, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu

In a marriage, revenge is often petty and therefore easy to excuse. The small cut, repeated, is how love is replaced by a contest. Mercy is leaving one cut unanswered.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is umgogodla, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 胳 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Do one undeserved kindness where you are keeping score. Do not mention the score.

z: 胴 umgogodla, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Accountability begins when you can say, the heat was mine. Wisdom begins when you can say, it had a better door. Compassion begins when the person you nearly burned is still in the room, and you stay.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is umgogodla, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 胴 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: When the heat rises, name who you are actually keeping safe. Put your body between the danger and the child. Do not spend the heat on the child.

z: 胵 umgogodla, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Self-reflection is the moment you notice you needed to win. Accountability is saying so before you are forced. The turn from pride to dignity is mostly this small honesty.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is umgogodla, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 胵 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Once, take the lower seat on purpose. Let someone in the house finish a story you could have told better.

z: 胸 umgogodla, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Siblings are assigned the same story and different gifts. Envy calls this injustice. Admiration calls it a house with more than one lamp. Both lamps belong on the table.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is umgogodla, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 胸 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Say out loud, in the hearing of the person, the exact good you wished were yours. Then leave it theirs.

z: 胻 umgogodla, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu
line:
Many houses, under many names, give the same command: do not be ruled by dread, and do not despise the person who is. The strong are asked to stay, not to sneer.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is umgogodla, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 胻 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Stay until the scared person is breathing slowly. Do not explain the dark away before you have sat in it.

z: 胼 imizwa yokuphumula, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Hospitality is the oldest sociology of the lasting house. The stranger eats first. The family that cannot do this for a guest will eventually fail to do it for itself.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 胼 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Pass the best portion first. The first piece teaches the house what it is.

z: 脂 imizwa yokuphumula, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Siblings remember the name they were called on the worst day. Do not give them that name. Give them the name of the good you have actually seen them do.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 脂 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Speak the true sentence. Keep the second one, the one that only wanted to win.

z: 脅 imizwa yokuphumula, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Children who are met with contempt learn to hide the clumsy part, which is most of them. Appreciation gives that part a chair.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 脅 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Look at one ordinary object they mended or prepared, and say what it cost them.

z: 脆 imizwa yokuphumula, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
The old practice of sitting with the sick, of keeping watch, of not filling the air, is this turn. Do not rush to be useful. Be there.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 脆 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: If your quiet has been a punishment, break it with one gentle sentence and then stay.

z: 脇 imizwa yokuphumula, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
The wisdom shared by many houses is hard: do not let the sun go down on a break you are willing to heal, and do not call it healing if you are only waiting to retell it.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 脇 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: If you were the one who broke trust, say what you did without a speech about why it was almost fair.

z: 脈 imizwa yokuphumula, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Children grieve in strange hours and then ask for ordinary things. Both are grief. Answer the ordinary thing. Do not make them perform a sadness you can recognize.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 脈 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Bring food. Take the lower seat. Stay past the moment you become uncomfortable.

z: 脉 imizwa yokuphumula, phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
A child who sees an adult look again, after a bad day, learns that a bad day is not a verdict. This is worth more than any optimism you could announce.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, phezulu, ngakwesokudla. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 脉 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Make one plan for tomorrow small enough that both of you can keep it.

z: 脊 imizwa yokuphumula, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Children are the usual casualties of a score kept between adults. They did not agree to carry it. Mercy toward the person you resent is also protection of the child.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 脊 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Leave one cut unanswered today. Do not announce the leaving.

z: 脍 imizwa yokuphumula, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Siblings fight because they share a roof and a hunger. The fight is not the failure. The failure is when the stronger one discovers a liking for the smaller one's fear. Protection refuses that discovery.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 脍 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Before the second loud sentence, step into the doorway, not toward the person. Let the heat guard the house from outside.

z: 脖 imizwa yokuphumula, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Brothers and sisters are the first public. What you do to be admired at home becomes the way they will treat their own children. Give them a dignity they can copy.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 脖 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Kneel, or sit, so your eyes meet a child's. Stay there until the conversation is theirs.

z: 脘 imizwa yokuphumula, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
The teachings that endured all warn the eye. They also bless the eye that rejoices. Rejoicing is not a mood. It is a decision made again each time the other person shines.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 脘 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Ask the person to show you how they did the thing. Be a student for ten minutes.

z: 脚 imizwa yokuphumula, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Fear of the future makes a house small. Courage does not enlarge the future. It keeps today's people inside the house while the future remains unknown.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 脚 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Hold the doorway. Let the frightened one see that you are not leaving.

z: 脛 imizwa yokuphumula, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Psychology is simple here. The closed hand teaches the body that the world is about to run out. The open hand teaches it that tomorrow includes other people.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 脛 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Feed the guest, or the youngest, before you take your own share.

z: 脞 imizwa yokuphumula, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Gossip is how a house talks about its own when they have left the room. Healing speech waits until they are back, and then says the hard thing to the face, cleanly.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokunxele. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 脞 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Say the hard thing to the face, once, cleanly, with no audience.

z: 脣 imizwa yokuphumula, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Across the old writings, the warning against scoffing is constant. A scoffer cannot be taught, and a house that scoffs cannot learn itself.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 脣 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Remove the sneer from a sentence and speak it again. Notice how much of it was only the sneer.

z: 脤 imizwa yokuphumula, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Some truths are not ready for speech. Presence holds them without using them as a weapon. A weaponized silence is still a weapon.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, maphakathi phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 脤 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Sit with a person who is not ready to speak. Let ten minutes pass without fixing them.

z: 脧 imizwa yokuphumula, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
A child who watches a break become a lifelong trial learns that love is a court. A child who watches a break become a mended bowl learns that love can survive its own failure.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 脧 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Decide, and say, whether the person is still a member. Do not leave them in a fog.

z: 脩 imizwa yokuphumula, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Compassion is grief that has recognized itself in another body and does not hurry it. Hurry is fear. The unhurried hour is the gift.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, maphakathi, ngakwesokunxele. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 脩 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Leave the empty place unspoken-of only if the grieving person wishes it. Otherwise, speak the name.

z: 脬 imizwa yokuphumula, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
The sciences of a lasting household call this resilience. The older word is faithfulness. It does not deny the dark. It refuses to let the dark be the only speaker.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 脬 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Set one place at the table that despair said was pointless. Eat there.

z: 脯 imizwa yokuphumula, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Many sacred traditions, in different grammars, say the same hard thing: the injury stops when someone declines to pass it on. This is not weakness. It is the end of a chain.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, maphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 脯 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: If a child is carrying a feud that belongs to adults, take it back. Say that it is not theirs.

z: 脱 imizwa yokuphumula, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
At the table, anger wants the last word. The last word is rarely food. Let the sentence end before it becomes the story the children will tell about this house.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 脱 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Teach the strong child to stand in front of the smaller one. That is anger, turned, and it can be learned young.

z: 脳 imizwa yokuphumula, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
The guest at the table is a test you did not schedule. If your worth requires the guest to be less clever, less beautiful, less faithful, your worth is a costume. Take it off.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 脳 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Praise a person in the house for a quality you do not share. Do not add a correction.

z: 脵 imizwa yokuphumula, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
What you wish were yours, name it exactly, in the hearing of the person who has it. Then do not reach. The naming is the confession. The not-reaching is the turn.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 脵 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: When a sibling is praised, add one true sentence of your own. Do not balance it with your own news.

z: 脹 imizwa yokuphumula, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Name the loss you are counting. Often it is a person in the room, not a disaster outside. Then put your body beside that person. That is the whole practice.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, maphakathi ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 脹 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Stay until the scared person is breathing slowly. Do not explain the dark away before you have sat in it.

z: 脽 imizwa yokuphumula, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Give before you calculate whether you will be thanked. Thanks are not the food. If you require them, you have made a trade, and a trade is not yet a family.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 脽 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Pass the best portion first. The first piece teaches the house what it is.

z: 脾 imizwa yokuphumula, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Wisdom is not silence forever. There is a time to speak. The test is whether the words can be repeated in front of the person, and still be a kindness.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 脾 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Speak the true sentence. Keep the second one, the one that only wanted to win.

z: 腆 imizwa yokuphumula, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Look at the work you have stopped seeing. Name it. The naming is not flattery. It is the return of sight, and sight is the turn.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 腆 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Thank a person for a labor you have stopped seeing. Thank the labor, not their temperament.

z: 腊 imizwa yokuphumula, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to be interesting. You do have to be in the house.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 腊 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to perform a talk.

z: 腋 imizwa yokuphumula, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Accountability is the first half. Without it, forgiveness is a fog. The one who broke the trust says what was done, without a speech about why it was almost justified.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 腋 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Name the break once, without extra charges. Then do one small trustworthy thing, and repeat it tomorrow.

z: 腎 imizwa yokuphumula, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
The oldest writings are full of lament, not because lament is holy by itself, but because love that cannot lament becomes hard. Let the house be soft enough to cry.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 腎 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Do not hurry a grieving person into cheer. Let the absent name be said.

z: 腐 imizwa yokuphumula, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
Despair often tells the truth about pain and then adds a lie about forever. Keep the truth. Decline the forever. Forever is not a fact available to a person at a window.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 腐 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Make one plan for tomorrow small enough that both of you can keep it.

z: 腑 imizwa yokuphumula, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Accountability remains. Mercy is not the cancellation of truth. It is the decision that truth will not be used as a knife at breakfast for the next twenty years.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 腑 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Leave one cut unanswered today. Do not announce the leaving.

z: 腓 imizwa yokuphumula, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu
line:
An elder who has turned anger into protection does not become mild. The wall is still warm. What changes is the face it turns toward. It faces the street, not the cradle.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is imizwa yokuphumula, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 腓 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Before the second loud sentence, step into the doorway, not toward the person. Let the heat guard the house from outside.

z: 腔 i-neuron, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
An elder's dignity is not the right to be obeyed in every small thing. It is the right to be respected while still listening. The listening is what makes the respect true.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is i-neuron, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 腔 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Admit one small wrong without a speech about your intentions. Stop when the admission is complete.

z: 腕 i-neuron, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Across generations, envy of the young is fear of being finished. Admiration of the young is how an elder stays in the story without owning it.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is i-neuron, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 腕 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Clap, or thank, before you comment. Let the first sound from you be glad.

z: 腟 i-neuron, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
An elder who has been afraid and stayed is a better teacher than an elder who claims never to have shaken. The shaking, survived, is the lesson.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is i-neuron, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 腟 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Tell the truth you have been saving, and remain in the room after it is told.

z: 腠 i-neuron, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
An elder who gives the best piece away is not being careless with the future. The elder is showing the future how a house continues.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is i-neuron, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 腠 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Put one thing you were keeping back into the middle of the table.

z: 腥 i-neuron, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
An elder's stories are a kind of speech that builds or bends a family. Tell the story in which people are repaired. The other story will tell itself.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is i-neuron, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 腥 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Say the hard thing to the face, once, cleanly, with no audience.

z: 腦 i-neuron, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
An elder who still notices the small faithfulness in the house is a gift to the young. The young become what is noticed.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is i-neuron, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 腦 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Remove the sneer from a sentence and speak it again. Notice how much of it was only the sneer.

z: 腧 i-neuron, phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
An elder's quiet can be a shelter or a locked door. The young can tell which, by whether they are welcome to come and say nothing beside you.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is i-neuron, phezulu, ngakwesokudla. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 腧 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Sit with a person who is not ready to speak. Let ten minutes pass without fixing them.

z: 腨 i-neuron, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Some breaks end a household. That too can be told with dignity. Forgiveness then is the refusal to poison the years that follow. The children still have to live in them.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is i-neuron, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 腨 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Eat together once without retelling the wound. Let the meal be only a meal.

z: 腩 i-neuron, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
An elder who speaks of the dead by name, without recruiting the young into despair, gives the family its memory and its future in the same breath.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is i-neuron, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 腩 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Answer the ordinary request of a grieving child. Do not make them perform a sadness you recognize.

z: 腫 i-neuron, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
An elder who has looked again, many mornings, is a quiet argument against the lie. Do not turn the elder into a slogan. Let the morning itself be seen.

This is the work of a marriage. The member drawn is i-neuron, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele. Treat it as a member of the house, not as a specimen. 腫 is the seal, not the subject. The subject is the living relation.
practice: Decline the word forever. Keep the true sentence about the pain, and stop before the lie.

z: 腭 i-neuron, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
An elder who lays down a feud gives the young a future that is not already written. That is one of the last great gifts a generation can give the next.

line:

z: 舩 i-neuron, umnkantsha womgogodla, umsipha, phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
An elder who has looked again, many mornings, is a quiet argument against the lie. Do not turn the elder into a slogan. Let the morning itself be seen.

practice: Open the curtain before you decide what the day is. Let the house see you do it.
